entities.summary: Muhammad Hamdan Dagalo Musa, commonly known by the nom de guerre Hemedti, is the military head of the paramilitary Rapid Support Forces (RSF), which is involved in the Sudanese civil war against the Sudanese Armed Forces (SAF) led by Abdel Fattah al-Burhan. He is also serving as the chairman of the presidential council of the de facto (unrecognized) Government of Peace and Unity since 2025.
